left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Informed consent is obtained from the participant

right.raw_text: -  The participant is clinically diagnosed with Parkinson's disease  [OR] or the individual is a family member  [OR] of a participant with LRRK2 parkinsonism or is a member of a high risk population with an early PD onset

left.raw_text: -  The participant is equal to or older than 18 years old

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Inability to provide informed consent

left.raw_text: -  The participant is not suffering from Parkinson's disease  [OR] or the individual is not  [OR] a family member of a participant with LRRK2 parkinsonism or is not a member of a high risk population

right.raw_text: -  The participant is younger than 18 years old
